updates.title: New Government Result Portal 2026
updates.content: The college now uses XYZ Maharashtra portal (xyzportal.gov.in) for result checking.

updates.title: Academic Admissions Open for 2026-27
updates.content: Admissions are actively open for First Year UG (B.Sc CS, B.Sc IT, BCA, BBA, B.Com, BAF, BMS, BA) and PG programmes for Academic Year 2026-27. Submit enrollment forms at the administrative office.

updates.title: Government MahaDBT Scholarship Form Filling Desk
updates.content: The college online form filling desk is operational in the library Annexure to assist SC/ST/OBC/VJNT/EBC students in submitting MahaDBT scholarship forms. Bring required Tehsildar income certificate and caste documents.

updates.title: University Examination & Result Portal
updates.content: Students can access upcoming semester exam time tables, hall tickets, and declared university results through the University of Mumbai Examination portal and college notice board.
